mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to potential monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, which is likely to boost corporate earnings and lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals a supply-side contraction, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO < 12-month MA and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, but S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real final sales (RSAFS) below its 6-month moving average signals weakening consumer demand, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS < 6-month MA and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals accommodative monetary policy in an inflationary environment, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL increases, but S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average signals strong economic growth, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 > 12-month MA and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.
